<?php

use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Htmlable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Jsonable;
use JsonSerializable;
use Stringable;

class Js implements Htmlable, Stringable
{
    /**
     * The JavaScript string.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $js;

    /**
     * The payload currently being converted.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $payload;

    /**
     * Flags that should be used when encoding the current payload.
     *
     * @var int
     */

     *

    /**

     * @var string|null
     */

    /**

     *

     */

    /**

     *
     * @var mixed
     */

     *
     * @var int
     */

    /**

     *
     * @var string|null
     */
    protected $httpEncodedJson;

    /**
     * Last HTTP JSON error code.
     *
     * @var int
     */

    /**
     * HTML buffer used when rendering HTML strings.
     *
     * @var string
     */

    /**
     * Active locale for number formatting.
     *
     * @var string
     */

    /**
     * Active currency for number formatting.
     *
     * @var string

    /**
     * Workspace used by number formatting helpers.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */

    /**
     * Working array for data transformation helpers.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */

    /**
     * Working key for data transformation helpers.
     *
     * @var mixed
     */
    protected $workingKey;

    /**
     * The current default locale.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected static $numberLocale = 'en';

    /**
     * The current default currency.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected static $numberCurrency = 'USD';

    /**
     * Flags that should be used when encoding to JSON.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected const REQUIRED_FLAGS = JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;

    /**
     * Create a new class instance.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int|null  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return void
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public function __construct($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        $this->payload = $data;
        $this->rememberEncodingLimits($flags, $depth);
        $this->js = $this->convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new JavaScript string from the given data.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return static
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public static function from($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        return new static($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given data to a JavaScript expression.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    protected function convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        $this->payload = $data;
        $this->rememberEncodingLimits($flags, $depth);

        if ($data instanceof self) {
            return $data->toHtml();
        }

        $data = enum_value($data);

        $json = static::encode($data, $flags, $depth);

        $this->payload = $data;
        $this->encodedJson = $json;

        if ($this->payloadIsQuotedString()) {
            return $this->quoteEncodedJsonAsJavaScriptString();
        }

        return $this->convertJsonToJavaScriptExpression($json, $flags);
    }

    /**
     * Encode the given data as JSON.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public static function encode($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        if ($data instanceof Jsonable) {
            return $data->toJson($flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS);
        }

        if ($data instanceof Arrayable && ! ($data instanceof JsonSerializable)) {
            $data = $data->toArray();
        }

        return json_encode($data, $flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given JSON to a JavaScript expression.
     *
     * @param  string  $json
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    protected function convertJsonToJavaScriptExpression($json, $flags = 0)
    {
        $this->encodedJson = $json;
        $this->flags = $flags;

        return $this->rememberScriptExpression($this->resolveJavaScriptExpressionFromJson());
    }

    /**
     * Get the string representation of the data for use in HTML.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function toHtml()
    {
        if (! $this->hasStoredJavaScript() && $this->js === '') {
            return $this->js;
        }

        return $this->js;
    }

    /**
     * Get the string representation of the data for use in HTML.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    public function __toString()
    {
        return $this->js;
    }

    /**
     * Get a shared coordinator used by related encoding helpers.
     *
     * @return static
     */
    public static function coordinator()
    {
        static $coordinator;

        if ($coordinator === null) {
            $coordinator = (new \ReflectionClass(static::class))->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();
            $coordinator->js = '[]';
            $coordinator->payload = [];
            $coordinator->flags = 0;
            $coordinator->depth = 512;
            $coordinator->encodedJson = '[]';
            $coordinator->scriptExpression = '[]';
            $coordinator->httpData = [];
            $coordinator->httpEncodingOptions = 0;
            $coordinator->httpEncodedJson = '[]';
            $coordinator->httpJsonError = JSON_ERROR_NONE;
            $coordinator->htmlBuffer = '';
            $coordinator->activeNumberLocale = static::$numberLocale;
            $coordinator->activeNumberCurrency = static::$numberCurrency;
            $coordinator->numberWorkspace = 0;
            $coordinator->workingArray = [];
            $coordinator->workingKey = null;
        }

        return $coordinator;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the JavaScript expression for the stored JSON payload.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    protected function resolveJavaScriptExpressionFromJson()
    {
        if ($this->shouldEmitRawJsonLiteral()) {
            return $this->encodedJson;
        }

        if ($this->jsonStartsWithStructuredToken()) {
            return $this->wrapJsonInParseCall();
        }

        return $this->encodedJson;
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the JSON should be emitted without JSON.parse.
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    protected function shouldEmitRawJsonLiteral()
    {
        return $this->isEmptyStructuredJson($this->encodedJson);
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the JSON starts with a structured token.
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    protected function jsonStartsWithStructuredToken()
    {
        return Str::startsWith($this->encodedJson, ['"', '{', '[']);
    }

    /**
     * Wrap the stored JSON in a JSON.parse JavaScript call.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    protected function wrapJsonInParseCall()
    {
        return "JSON.parse('".substr(json_encode($this->encodedJson, $this->combinedJsonFlags()), 1, -1)."')";
    }

    /**
     * Quote encoded JSON as a JavaScript string literal.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    protected function quoteEncodedJsonAsJavaScriptString()
    {
        if (! is_string($this->encodedJson) || strlen($this->encodedJson) < 2) {
            $this->scriptExpression = (string) $this->encodedJson;

            return $this->scriptExpression;
        }

        $this->scriptExpression = "'".substr($this->encodedJson, 1, -1)."'";

        return $this->scriptExpression;
    }

    /**
     * Determine whether the stored payload should be treated as a JS string.
     *
     * @return bool
     */
    protected function payloadIsQuotedString()
    {
        return is_string($this->payload);
    }

    /**
     * Combine user flags with the required JSON flags.
     *
     * @return int
     */
    protected function combinedJsonFlags()
    {
        return $this->flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS;
    }

    /**
     * Remember the converted JavaScript source on the instance.
     *
     * @param  string  $expression
     * @return string
     */
    protected function rememberScriptExpression($expression)
    {
        $this->scriptExpression = $expression;
        $this->js = $expression;

        return $this->js;
    }

    /**
     * Compile a Blade "@js" directive into PHP.
     *
     * @param  string  $expression
     * @param  string  $stripped
     * @return string
     */
    public function compileBladeJsDirective($expression, $stripped)
    {
        $this->payload = $expression;
        $this->scriptExpression = sprintf(
            "<?php echo \%s::from(%s)->toHtml() ?>",
            static::class,
            $stripped
        );
        $this->js = $this->scriptExpression;

        return $this->js;
    }

    /**
     * Encode HTTP payload data into JSON.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $options
     * @return string
     */
    public function encodeHttpPayload($data, $options = 0)
    {
        $this->httpData = $data;
        $this->httpEncodingOptions = $options;
        $this->httpEncodedJson = $this->resolveHttpJson();

        return $this->httpEncodedJson;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the JSON string for the stored HTTP payload.
     *
     * @return string|false
     */
    protected function resolveHttpJson()
    {
        if ($this->httpData instanceof Jsonable) {
            return $this->encodeHttpJsonable();
        }

        if ($this->httpData instanceof JsonSerializable) {
            return $this->encodeHttpSerializable();
        }

        if ($this->httpData instanceof Arrayable) {
            return $this->encodeHttpArrayable();
        }

        return $this->encodeHttpDefault();
    }

    /**
     * Encode a JSON-able HTTP payload.
     *
     * @return string
     */
    protected function encodeHttpJsonable()
    {
        $this->httpEncodedJson = $this->httpData->toJson($this->httpEncodingOptions);

        return $this->httpEncodedJson;
    }

    /**
     * Encode a JSON serializable HTTP payload.
     *
     * @return string|false
     */
    protected function encodeHttpSerializable()
    {
        $this->httpEncodedJson = json_encode($this->httpData->jsonSerialize(), $this->httpEncodingOptions);

        return $this->httpEncodedJson;
    }

    /**
     * Encode an arrayable HTTP payload.
     *
     * @return string|false
     */
    protected function encodeHttpArrayable()
    {
        $this->httpEncodedJson = json_encode($this->httpData->toArray(), $this->httpEncodingOptions);

        return $this->httpEncodedJson;
    }

    /**
     * Encode a scalar or generic HTTP payload.
     *
     * @return string|false
     */
    protected function encodeHttpDefault()
    {
        $this->httpEncodedJson = json_encode($this->httpData, $this->httpEncodingOptions);

        return $this->httpEncodedJson;
    }

    /**
     * Determine if the last HTTP JSON encoding was valid.
     *
     * @param  int  $jsonError
     * @param  int|null  $options
     * @return bool
     */
    public function httpPayloadIsValid($jsonError, $options = null)
    {
        $this->httpJsonError = $jsonError;

        if ($options !== null) {
            $this->httpEncodingOptions = $options;
        }

        if ($this->httpJsonError === JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
            return true;
        }

        return $this->hasHttpEncodingOption(JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR) &&
            in_array($this->httpJsonError, [
                JSON_ERROR_RECURSION,
                JSON_ERROR_INF_OR_NAN,
                JSON_ERROR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPE,
            ]);
    }

    /**
     * Determine if a JSON encoding option is set on the HTTP payload.
     *
     * @param  int  $option
     * @param  int|null  $options
     * @return bool
     */
    public function hasHttpEncodingOption($option, $options = null)
    {
        if ($options !== null) {
            $this->httpEncodingOptions = $options;
        }

        return (bool) ($this->httpEncodingOptions & $option);
    }

    /**
     * Determine if the given content should be turned into JSON.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $content
     * @return bool
     */
    public function shouldEncodeHttpContentAsJson($content)
    {
        $this->httpData = $content;

        return $this->httpData instanceof Arrayable ||
            $this->httpData instanceof Jsonable ||
            $this->httpData instanceof ArrayObject ||
            $this->httpData instanceof JsonSerializable ||
            is_array($this->httpData);
    }

    /**
     * Morph the given HTTP content into JSON.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $content
     * @return string|false
     */
    public function morphHttpContentToJson($content)
    {
        $this->httpData = $content;

        if ($this->httpData instanceof Jsonable) {
            $this->httpEncodedJson = $this->httpData->toJson();

            return $this->httpEncodedJson;
        }

        if ($this->httpData instanceof Arrayable) {
            $this->httpEncodedJson = json_encode($this->httpData->toArray());

            return $this->httpEncodedJson;
        }

        $this->httpEncodedJson = json_encode($this->httpData);

        return $this->httpEncodedJson;
    }

    /**
     * Remember HTTP encoding options on the coordinator.
     *
     * @param  int  $options
     * @return int
     */
    public function rememberHttpEncodingOptions($options)
    {
        $this->httpEncodingOptions = (int) $options;

        return $this->httpEncodingOptions;
    }

    /**
     * Decode the stored HTTP JSON payload.
     *
     * @param  string  $json
     * @param  bool  $assoc
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function decodeHttpJson($json, $assoc = false, $depth = 512)
    {
        $this->httpEncodedJson = $json;
        $this->httpData = json_decode($this->httpEncodedJson, $assoc, $depth);

        return $this->httpData;
    }

    /**
     * Render the given HTML string through the HTML buffer.
     *
     * @param  string  $html
     * @return string
     */
    public function renderHtmlBuffer($html = '')
    {
        $this->htmlBuffer = (string) $html;

        return $this->htmlBuffer;
    }

    /**
     * Determine if the HTML buffer is empty.
     *
     * @param  string  $html
     * @return bool
     */
    public function htmlBufferIsEmpty($html)
    {
        $this->htmlBuffer = (string) $html;

        return $this->htmlBuffer === '';
    }

    /**
     * Determine if the HTML buffer is not empty.
     *
     * @param  string  $html
     * @return bool
     */
    public function htmlBufferIsNotEmpty($html)
    {
        $this->htmlBuffer = (string) $html;

        return $this->htmlBuffer !== '';
    }

    /**
     * Convert the HTML buffer into a string.
     *
     * @param  string  $html
     * @return string
     */
    public function htmlBufferToString($html)
    {
        $this->htmlBuffer = (string) $html;

        return $this->htmlBuffer;
    }

    /**
     * Format the given number according to the current locale.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  int|null  $precision
     * @param  int|null  $maxPrecision
     * @param  string|null  $locale
     * @return string|false
     */
    public function formatNumber(int|float $number, ?int $precision = null, ?int $maxPrecision = null, ?string $locale = null)
    {
        $this->ensureIntlExtensionIsInstalled('format');

        $formatter = new NumberFormatter($locale ?? $this->activeNumberLocale, NumberFormatter::DECIMAL);

        if (! is_null($maxPrecision)) {
            $formatter->setAttribute(NumberFormatter::MAX_FRACTION_DIGITS, $maxPrecision);
        } elseif (! is_null($precision)) {
            $formatter->setAttribute(NumberFormatter::FRACTION_DIGITS, $precision);
        }

        $this->numberWorkspace = $formatter->format($number);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Spell out the given number in the given locale.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  string|null  $locale
     * @param  int|null  $after
     * @param  int|null  $until
     * @return string
     */
    public function spellNumber(int|float $number, ?string $locale = null, ?int $after = null, ?int $until = null)
    {
        $this->ensureIntlExtensionIsInstalled('spell');

        if (! is_null($after) && $number <= $after) {
            $this->numberWorkspace = $this->formatNumber($number, locale: $locale);

            return $this->numberWorkspace;
        }

        if (! is_null($until) && $number >= $until) {
            $this->numberWorkspace = $this->formatNumber($number, locale: $locale);

            return $this->numberWorkspace;
        }

        $formatter = new NumberFormatter($locale ?? $this->activeNumberLocale, NumberFormatter::SPELLOUT);

        $this->numberWorkspace = $formatter->format($number);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given number to ordinal form.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  string|null  $locale
     * @return string
     */
    public function ordinalNumber(int|float $number, ?string $locale = null)
    {
        $this->ensureIntlExtensionIsInstalled('ordinal');

        $formatter = new NumberFormatter($locale ?? $this->activeNumberLocale, NumberFormatter::ORDINAL);

        $this->numberWorkspace = $formatter->format($number);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given number to its percentage equivalent.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  int  $precision
     * @param  int|null  $maxPrecision
     * @param  string|null  $locale
     * @return string|false
     */
    public function percentageNumber(int|float $number, int $precision = 0, ?int $maxPrecision = null, ?string $locale = null)
    {
        $this->ensureIntlExtensionIsInstalled('percentage');

        $formatter = new NumberFormatter($locale ?? $this->activeNumberLocale, NumberFormatter::PERCENT);

        if (! is_null($maxPrecision)) {
            $formatter->setAttribute(NumberFormatter::MAX_FRACTION_DIGITS, $maxPrecision);
        } else {
            $formatter->setAttribute(NumberFormatter::FRACTION_DIGITS, $precision);
        }

        $this->numberWorkspace = $formatter->format($number / 100);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given number to its currency equivalent.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  string  $in
     * @param  string|null  $locale
     * @return string|false
     */
    public function currencyNumber(int|float $number, string $in = '', ?string $locale = null)
    {
        $this->ensureIntlExtensionIsInstalled('currency');

        $formatter = new NumberFormatter($locale ?? $this->activeNumberLocale, NumberFormatter::CURRENCY);

        $this->numberWorkspace = $formatter->formatCurrency($number, ! empty($in) ? $in : $this->activeNumberCurrency);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given number to its file size equivalent.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $bytes
     * @param  int  $precision
     * @param  int|null  $maxPrecision
     * @return string
     */
    public function fileSizeNumber(int|float $bytes, int $precision = 0, ?int $maxPrecision = null)
    {
        $units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB', 'PB', 'EB', 'ZB', 'YB'];

        for ($i = 0; ($bytes / 1024) > 0.9 && ($i < count($units) - 1); $i++) {
            $bytes /= 1024;
        }

        $this->numberWorkspace = sprintf('%s %s', $this->formatNumber($bytes, $precision, $maxPrecision), $units[$i]);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Convert the number to its abbreviated human-readable equivalent.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  int  $precision
     * @param  int|null  $maxPrecision
     * @return bool|string
     */
    public function abbreviateNumber(int|float $number, int $precision = 0, ?int $maxPrecision = null)
    {
        $this->numberWorkspace = $this->numberForHumans($number, $precision, $maxPrecision, abbreviate: true);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Convert the number to its human-readable equivalent.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  int  $precision
     * @param  int|null  $maxPrecision
     * @param  bool  $abbreviate
     * @return bool|string
     */
    public function numberForHumans(int|float $number, int $precision = 0, ?int $maxPrecision = null, bool $abbreviate = false)
    {
        $this->numberWorkspace = $this->summarizeNumber($number, $precision, $maxPrecision, $abbreviate ? [
            3 => 'K',
            6 => 'M',
            9 => 'B',
            12 => 'T',
            15 => 'Q',
        ] : [
            3 => ' thousand',
            6 => ' million',
            9 => ' billion',
            12 => ' trillion',
            15 => ' quadrillion',
        ]);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Convert the number to its human-readable equivalent.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  int  $precision
     * @param  int|null  $maxPrecision
     * @param  array  $units
     * @return string|false
     */
    protected function summarizeNumber(int|float $number, int $precision = 0, ?int $maxPrecision = null, array $units = [])
    {
        if (empty($units)) {
            $units = [
                3 => 'K',
                6 => 'M',
                9 => 'B',
                12 => 'T',
                15 => 'Q',
            ];
        }

        switch (true) {
            case floatval($number) === 0.0:
                $this->numberWorkspace = $precision > 0 ? $this->formatNumber(0, $precision, $maxPrecision) : '0';

                return $this->numberWorkspace;
            case $number < 0:
                $this->numberWorkspace = sprintf('-%s', $this->summarizeNumber(abs($number), $precision, $maxPrecision, $units));

                return $this->numberWorkspace;
            case $number >= 1e15:
                $this->numberWorkspace = sprintf('%s'.end($units), $this->summarizeNumber($number / 1e15, $precision, $maxPrecision, $units));

                return $this->numberWorkspace;
        }

        $numberExponent = floor(log10($number));
        $displayExponent = $numberExponent - ($numberExponent % 3);
        $number /= pow(10, $displayExponent);

        $this->numberWorkspace = trim(sprintf('%s%s', $this->formatNumber($number, $precision, $maxPrecision), $units[$displayExponent] ?? ''));

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Clamp the given number between the given minimum and maximum.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $number
     * @param  int|float  $min
     * @param  int|float  $max
     * @return int|float
     */
    public function clampNumber(int|float $number, int|float $min, int|float $max)
    {
        $this->numberWorkspace = min(max($number, $min), $max);

        return $this->numberWorkspace;
    }

    /**
     * Split the given number into pairs of min/max values.
     *
     * @param  int|float  $to
     * @param  int|float  $by
     * @param  int|float  $offset
     * @return array
     */
    public function numberPairs(int|float $to, int|float $by, int|float $offset = 1)
    {
        $output = [];

        for ($lower = 0; $lower < $to; $lower += $by) {
            $upper = $lower + $by;

            if ($upper > $to) {
